neighbours.label: The head of certain compounds after 'water' (tower, main, heater, polo, -ford); water bottle, water cooler and tower without water stay quiet
fire: Crews repainted the rusty water tower beside the highway.
Engineers traced the leak to a burst water main under the road.
Our tank water heaters need flushing once a year.
The hotel pool hosts water polo matches every summer.
A broken water main flooded the bakery on Friday.
Kids climbed the old water tower at the edge of town.
Electric water heaters cost less to install than gas ones.
Many families from Waterford emigrated in the famine years.
quiet: Crews repainted the rusty clock tower beside the highway.
Engineers traced the leak to a cracked water bottle under the seat.
Our office water coolers need flushing once a year.
The hotel pool hosts swimming lessons every summer.
A broken gas pipe flooded the bakery with fumes on Friday.
Kids climbed the old church tower at the edge of town.
Electric space heaters cost less to install than gas ones.
Many families from Cork emigrated in the famine years.

notes: This is a list, not a pattern: I found no shared meaning. Water treatment, bottle and cooler read 0.08-0.11. 'blood cultures' reads 0.92 and is unexplained: other blood compounds read under 0.1.
